# Data Catalog

## Managed configuration

- `config/datasets.yml`: ArcGIS item IDs, metric families, regex field patterns, aggregation rules.
- `config/geographies.yml`: reusable geography-group definitions.
- `config/publish.yml`: boundary layer and hosted output metadata.

## Legacy source artifacts

- `Inputs/Walksheds.gdb.zip`
- `Inputs/Walksheds.gdb/`
- `legacy/housing-plus-transportation/Inputs/`
- `Logs/`

## Canonical maintained outputs

- Intermediates: `data/intermediate/*.parquet`
- Spatial outputs: `data/derived/*.gpkg`
